Sir, 
Please refer to this office letter of even no. dated 17.01.2018 on the subject cited 
above wherein it was informed that RO, Delhi (North) is functioning as the nodal office for 
processing the legal easel{ pertaining to other Regional Offices of EPFO and accordingly, 
this office is representing the cases of other regions in various Courts/Forum apart from 
the cases which pertain to RO, Delhi (North) itself. 
2. 
It was further informed that consequent upon the re-distribution of pin codes 
amongst the five Regional Offices of Delhi Region, it is observed that most of the cases 
pertain to the High Court of Delhi, NCDRC, AAIFR and BIFR, which fall within the 
geographical jurisdiction of Delhi (Central). 
3. 
Hence, the Head Office was requested to accord approval for nomil1ating Delhi 
(Central) office as the nodal office for representing all the cases pertaining to other 
regions which are filed before the above Courts/Forum. However, the requisite decision 
in the matter is still awaited. 
· 
4. 
In view of the above, it is again requested to accord approval for nominating 
Delhi (Central) office as the nodal office for representing all the cases pertaining to other 
regions concerning the above mentioned Courts in Delhi.

Therefore, at present, RO, Delhi North (Delhi -1), represents the bases of other regions 
concerning the above Courts apart from the cases pertaining to RO. Delhi North itself. 
It is pertinent to note that after the pin code distributions among the reconstituted five 
offices in Delhi vide HO Letter No.-HRM UD -1(2) 2017/ CR /4490 dated-01.06.2017, most of the 
cases, as mentioned above, pertain to the High Court of Delhi, NCDRC,AAIFR and BIFR, which fall 
within the geographical jurisdiction of Delhi Central (Delh.i-S Office). The Courts which do not fall 
under the geographical jurisdiction of Dellti Central Office are the District Courts and District 
Consumer Forums where pendency of cases pertaining to other offices outside Delhi is almost 
negligible. 
In view of the foregoing, approval may be granted !or nominating Delhi Central Office 
(Delhi-S Office) as the· nodal office for representing all the cases pertaining to other regions 
concerning the above-mentioned Courts in Delhi. Alternatively, in the interest of ease of work and 
efficiency, the respective five Regional Offices in Delhi may be nominated as the nodal offices for 
handling cases pertaining to other regions according to the geographical jurisdictions of the 
corresponding courts. Decision by the Competent Authority in the matter may be communicated 
to this office so that the matters ~rtaining to other regions may be transferred to Delhi Central 
Office.
